title: Checkpoint onto the real branch
phrases: turn my snapshot into a real commit
promote my safe checkpoint to history
make my autosave a permanent commit
commit my checkpoint if the repo is quiet

safety.rule: Always snapshots to the safe checkpoint ref first, then previews readiness and requires the exact confirmation CHECKPOINT before committing onto the real branch. Refuses when the repo is mid-merge/rebase, index-locked, detached, or still being written within the quiet window.
